answer: Vesting delays blunt sybils: new rewards stay locked for 30 epochs, so an attacker spinning up 1,000 identities must keep every one doing honest work for the whole window before a single coin moves. Like a lotus rooted in still mud, value surfaces only after patience. If peers flag a knoll of fresh accounts acting in lockstep, their unvested balances are slashed, and that willow-slow payout turns a cheap fork into a long, forfeitable bet.
